name: Newborn Baby
overview: Scripture reveals that newborn babies are a precious heritage and reward from the Lord, intricately formed and known by God even before birth, as seen in Psalms 127:3 and Jeremiah 1:5. The growth and development of a child, both physically and spiritually, are sovereign works of God beyond human understanding (Ecclesiastes 11:5). From infancy, God ordains strength through the mouths of babes to confound enemies (Psalms 8:2), and He calls parents to diligently train their children in His ways so that they remain faithful throughout life (Proverbs 22:6).
